name: X, X Everywhere
look: A Toy Story still indoors. Buzz Lightyear, grinning, drapes an arm around Woody's shoulders and sweeps his other hand toward the distance, while Woody stares ahead with a worried, uneasy frown.
use: The top text names a thing and the bottom text says that thing is everywhere, as Buzz shows Woody something that is suddenly all around them, often annoying, overwhelming or unavoidable.
slots: the same thing, followed by everywhere (bottom)
describe: buzz lightyear showing woody something with his arm around him
toy story buzz pointing into the distance and woody looks worried
space ranger toy gesturing at everything while the cowboy looks nervous
two toys, one excited and pointing, the other one scared
cartoon astronaut with his arm around a cowboy showing him the view
origin: A still of Buzz Lightyear and Woody from Pixar's Toy Story films.
